name: The Valley of Serenity
description: A huge pastoral cavern region of the House where the cult lives.

timeline.summary: City, outside the door, tells Dawn he asked the Devouring Father to spare her and invites her to the Valley of Serenity.
timeline.quote: I asked him for your life, and he granted it to me

pages_say.description: The place where City invites Dawn to join his group for the Devouring Father's peace.
A huge pastoral cavern region of the House where the cult lives.
